evidence:
Built a criterion -> public-requirement map for all 2 gate criteria, 43 Functional criteria (total weight 58.5), 5 Polish and 5 Visual criteria. Nearly all map to explicit text in instruction.md or hireops_rules.md: 401/403/404 statuses (rules s1), places 1-50 whole number (s2), email case/field-tied refusal (s2), one-stage moves, rejected-from reopen, bottom arrival, Interview places, version 409 naming who (s3 'Two people at once'), focus on card controls (s3 'Shown at once'), bulk board order and all-or-none, undo semantics incl. restoring rejection reason (s3 Undo), activity lines (s4), 15 s live updates and preservation (s5), 30-message pages and anchor preservation, Enter/Shift+Enter, unread/seen/observer rule, drafts and session resume (s6), candidate wording and privacy (s7). Sign-in usage is a known false positive (SKILL.md:63; internal workbook annotation). Seed check: Lena's APP-301 has 3 messages, her read marker is 2, the third is from USR-REC3, so 'Lena starts with 1 unread' (hro_unread_counts) is derived from public seed data. Visual rows explicitly say layout/labels are the implementer's choice and require no phone/theme. Functional prompt line 15 says 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'.

INSTANCE 1 (blocking, hro_unread_counts, weight 2 of 58.5 functional, ~2.05% of total reward): tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:41 (protocol U) says 'Every reading in U is made without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page ... With Rafael's page on the Board, Tomas sends two messages; read Rafael's count on that conversation and his total, then open it'. The criterion (functional/judge.toml:335) requires 'Rafael's count for that conversation rises by exactly two and his total by two within 15 seconds without reload or click' and 'Fails if any count ... changes only after a reload or navigation'. The public rule (hireops_rules.md:153-154) only says 'Unread counts are shown per conversation and as one total for the person' and s5 says unread counts change live; nothing requires the per-conversation count to be visible on the Board view. Reading it from the Board is only possible because the golden puts a per-conversation unread badge on each board card (solution/app/public/js/board.js:253 'a.unread ? el("span", { class: "badge", ... })'), a reference-only design choice. A correct app that shows the live total in its navigation and per-conversation counts in the Conversations list (both updating live) gives the judge nothing to read for 'count on that conversation' while forbidden to navigate, so the row is likely scored 0 or as 'changes only after navigation'.

Secondary instances reported (not independently blocking, judge-interpretation risk): (a) hro_refused_put_back (functional/judge.toml:137) narrows rules s3 'keyboard focus stays on that card's controls' to 'document.activeElement inside the card'; an app whose move controls live in an opened card-details drawer/dialog for that card satisfies the rule but could be read as focus outside 'the card' (P3). (b) hro_pol_failed_send (polish/judge.toml:50) requires 'nothing was added to the conversation' and 'A visible explanation appears'; rules s6 only require the unsent text to stay in the box. Explanation is a reasonable professional default, but an app that also shows a clearly marked 'not sent / retry' bubble while keeping the text in the box conforms yet may be failed on 'nothing was added' (P3). (c) hro_pol_session_resume ends the session via explicit sign-out in a second tab; rules s6 say drafts survive 'after the session ends mid-reply', so this is defensible, but an app that purges a user's drafts on deliberate sign-out could argue conformity (Note). (d) hro_add_candidate 'appears ... with the entered name and email' does not say on the card face, so card details suffice (Note, no defect).

No runtime evidence exercises these alternatives: raw-evidence-index.json scope states full configured grading, reward discrimination and Oracle/target scores are absent; the finding is from source/criterion analysis against the frozen bytes.
counterexample: Conforming app: staff nav shows 'Conversations (N)' total badge that updates by polling within 15 s; the Conversations list shows per-conversation unread counts that also update live and clear on open; board cards carry no unread badge (rules never ask for one). Under protocol U the judge, kept on the Board with no navigation or click, sees the total rise by 2 but cannot read 'Rafael's count on that conversation', and the criterion's 'changes only after a reload or navigation' clause invites a 0 for hro_unread_counts (weight 2) despite every public unread rule being met. Conversely, a weak app that shows a live per-card badge on the board but a stale Conversations list would pass this leg.
suggested_fix: In protocol U keep Rafael's page on the Conversations list (without opening Tomas's conversation) instead of the Board, or allow in-app navigation to the conversation list after the 15-second no-touch wait while requiring the total to have risen live; and loosen hro_refused_put_back to 'focus on that card's own controls (on the card or its open details)'.
